steps: Whisk the curd until smooth, then whisk in a third of the besan, the turmeric, half the chilli powder and most of the salt.
Whisk in about 200 ml water a person until the mix is thin and has no lumps.
For pakoras, mix the rest of the besan with most of the onion, the rest of the chilli and salt, half the garam masala and a splash of water.
Heat most of the oil on medium, drop in spoonfuls of batter and fry, turning once, until crisp and golden. Drain on paper.
In a deep pot, heat the rest of the oil on low and add the cumin and hing. Let the cumin crackle.
Add the remaining onion with the ginger, garlic and green chilli and cook on low-medium for about 3 minutes, until soft.
Pour in the curd mix and stir often on medium until it boils, then simmer on low for 20 to 25 minutes, until it thickens.
Add the pakoras and the rest of the garam masala, cover and leave for 8 to 10 minutes to soak, then serve with rice.
note: The oil includes about 10 ml a person that the pakoras soak up while frying; you need a deeper pan of oil to fry them in.
